_note: 學習路徑內容第23批 #4／6：核心高頻字彙──感受與日常需求（eng.t_mid.vocab.core-1200，會考級／中階）。注意：vocab.core-1200 是『字彙廣度／精熟』型 KP（教育部參考 1200 核心字），無法由單一單元承載全部字；本單元取一組具代表性的核心高頻字（thirsty／borrow／lend／repair／leave）做主題字彙單元，以『字義在情境中正確運用』方式練習、exercise 此 KP。can_do／title 誠實標示為『一組核心字』，不宣稱精熟全部 1200 字。誘答鎖『以情境語意唯一判定、選項字義彼此明顯不同』避免近義詞第二正解；borrow／lend 方向對比明確。字義依 Cambridge／Oxford 詞典，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix cvb_）。

units.title_zh: 核心高頻字彙（感受與日常需求）
units.can_do: 我能在句子情境中正確運用一組教育部參考核心高頻字（描述感受與日常需求，如 thirsty／borrow／lend／repair／leave）。
units.situation_group: 字彙：核心高頻字（感受與日常需求）
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'thirsty' is an adjective meaning needing or wanting to drink: 'After the run, I was thirsty.'
claims.verification_ref: thirsty＝口渴、想喝水（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'borrow' means to take and use something that you will give back later; 'lend' means to give something to someone to use for a time: 'Can I borrow your pen?' / 'I'll lend you my pen.'
claims.verification_ref: borrow＝向別人借入（之後要還）、lend＝借出給別人（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'repair' (also 'fix') means to make something that is broken work or look good again: 'My dad repaired my bike.'
claims.verification_ref: repair＝修理、把壞掉的東西修好（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'leave' means to go away from a place or person: 'We must leave now or we'll miss the train.' (The opposite of arriving.)
claims.verification_ref: leave＝離開（某地／某人）、與 arrive 相反（Cambridge/Oxford 詞典）；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: This unit practises a group of core, high-frequency words. 'thirsty' means wanting to drink. After the long run, I was thirsty. 累積核心字量，能讀懂更多句子。thirsty＝口渴。
After the long run, I was really thirsty and drank a lot of water.
teach.zh_hint: 長跑後我很渴，喝了很多水。thirsty＝口渴、想喝水。

teach.body: 'borrow' is to take something you will give back; 'lend' is to give it to someone for a time. Can I borrow your pen? I'll lend you mine. borrow＝向別人借入、lend＝借出給別人。
May I borrow your eraser? I forgot mine.
teach.zh_hint: 我可以向你借橡皮擦嗎？我忘了帶。borrow＝向別人借入。

teach.body: 'repair' (= fix) means to mend something broken; 'leave' means to go away from a place. My dad repaired my bike. We must leave now. repair＝修理、leave＝離開。
The worker repaired the broken chair quickly.
teach.zh_hint: 工人很快把壞掉的椅子修好。repair＝修理。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：It was a hot day, so the children were very ____ and wanted some water.（想喝水）

distractor_rationales.hungry: hungry 是『餓』，但句中想要的是水（water），應用 thirsty。
distractor_rationales.sleepy: sleepy 是『睏、想睡』，與想喝水無關。
distractor_rationales.angry: angry 是『生氣』，與想喝水無關。

practice.feedback: wanted some water → thirsty（口渴、想喝水）。

practice.stem: 選正確：I forgot my umbrella. Can I ____ yours?（我忘了帶傘，可以向你借嗎？）

distractor_rationales.lend: lend 是『借出給別人』；這裡是我要向你借入，用 borrow。

practice.feedback: Can I borrow yours?：向別人借入用 borrow。

practice.stem: 選正確：You left your book at home? I can ____ you mine.（我可以借給你我的）

distractor_rationales.borrow: borrow 是『向別人借入』；這裡是我借出給你，用 lend。
distractor_rationales.keep: keep 是『保留、留著』，語意不對。

practice.feedback: I can lend you mine：借出給別人用 lend。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：My watch is broken. I need to ____ it.（修理）

distractor_rationales.throw: throw 是『丟』，不是把壞掉的東西修好。

practice.feedback: broken → repair（修理、把壞掉的東西修好）。

practice.stem: 選最合適的字：We must ____ home now, or we'll miss the train.（現在必須離開家）

distractor_rationales.arrive: arrive 是『到達』，方向相反；『或會錯過火車』表示現在要離開，用 leave。
distractor_rationales.stay: stay 是『留下』，與『會錯過火車』矛盾。

practice.feedback: or we'll miss the train → must leave now（離開）。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: I was so thirsty that I drank a whole bottle of water.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：thirsty、so…that、a whole bottle of water、句尾句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。核心字重讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: Can I borrow your pencil for a minute?
lines.intonation: borrow 重讀、句尾 minute 微升（詢問）

lines.text: My father repaired the old clock yesterday.
lines.intonation: repaired 重讀、yesterday 句尾下收
